We need propose retrosynthesis route up to 3 steps, leaves must be commercially available, total price <=9999 (we can't check price but assume common reagents). Need to output JSON route.

We need to find disconnections. Target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

Structure: a tolyl sulfonamide attached to phenyl with a trans-α,β-unsaturated amide attached to an aniline (anilide). So overall: p-tolyl-sulfonyl-phenyl-CH=CH-CO-NH-aniline (with NH2 on aniline). Could be built via sulfonylation of aniline with p-toluenesulfonyl chloride? Actually sulfonamide: NS(=O)(=O) attached to phenyl ring (the sulfonyl attached to phenyl). The sulfonamide nitrogen is attached to the tolyl phenyl? Wait SMILES: Cc1ccc(N S(=O)(=O) c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)N c3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1. So the sulfonamide nitrogen attached to tolyl ring (para-methyl phenyl) and sulfonyl attached to second phenyl ring (c2...). So it's a sulfonamide linking two aryl groups.

Thus retrosynthesis: disconnection at sulfonamide N-S bond: could form via sulfonyl chloride reacting with aniline (aryl amine). So precursor 1: p-toluidine (4-methylaniline) (SMILES: Cc1ccc(N)cc1). Precursor 2: aryl sulfonyl chloride: 4-(...?) Actually the sulfonyl attached to phenyl bearing the unsaturated amide side chain. So we need 4-(...)-phenylsulfonyl chloride (SMILES: ClS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(... )cc1). The side chain is /C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N attached at para position? In SMILES: c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2 attached to sulfonyl. So the phenyl ring with side chain at para relative to sulfonyl? Not important.

Thus step1: sulfonyl chloride + p-toluidine -> target (sulfonamide formation). That's one step.

Now need to get sulfonyl chloride precursor. Could be made from corresponding sulfonic acid via thionyl chloride, but we can also purchase aryl sulfonyl chloride commercially. Likely 4-(E-... )-phenylsulfonyl chloride is not common. Maybe better to disconnect at the C=C double bond: do a Heck coupling between aryl bromide and acrylate? Or do a Wittig to install alkene.

Alternative route: Build the unsaturated amide side chain first: start from aniline (c3ccccc3N) and react with acryloyl chloride to give acryloyl anilide, then do a Heck coupling with aryl bromide bearing sulfonyl group? But we need also sulfonamide.

Simplify: Use three steps: 1) Form amide: aniline + acryloyl chloride -> N-phenylacrylamide (C=CH-CO-NH-Ph). Then 2) Suzuki coupling of aryl bromide (with sulfonyl group) to the alkene? Actually need to attach the phenyl ring with sulfonyl to the alkene via a Heck reaction: aryl bromide (para-sulfonyl phenyl bromide) + N-phenylacrylamide -> product with trans-alkene. Then 3) sulfonamide formation with p-toluidine? Wait sulfonyl already attached to phenyl ring; the sulfonamide nitrogen is attached to p-tolyl. So we need to attach p-toluidine to sulfonyl chloride after the Heck step. So step order: first make sulfonyl chloride (commercial maybe). Then sulfonamide formation with p-toluidine gives sulfonamide intermediate (aryl-sulfonyl-p-toluidine). Then perform Heck coupling with N-phenylacrylamide? But sulfonamide nitrogen is attached to p-tolyl, not interfering.

Thus final three steps: (1) Purchase p-toluidine (commercial). (2) Purchase 4-(E-...)-phenylsulfonyl chloride (maybe not commercial). Might be expensive.

Alternative: Use commercially available 4-bromobenzenesulfonyl chloride (p-bromobenzenesulfonyl chloride) then do Suzuki coupling to install the side chain phenyl with unsaturated amide? Could attach via Suzuki to bromophenyl after sulfonamide formation? But sulfonyl chloride reacts with amine; after sulfonamide formation we have sulfonamide attached to p-tolyl and sulfonyl attached to phenyl bearing bromide at para. Then we can do Suzuki coupling with a boronic acid bearing the side chain (e.g., (E)-3-(phenylamido)styryl boronic acid). Might be complex.

Given limited time, propose simple route assuming commercial availability of both aryl sulfonyl chloride and p-toluidine and acryloyl chloride and aniline. Use three steps:

Step1: Form N-phenylacrylamide: aniline + acryloyl chloride -> intermediate A (SMILES: C=CC(=O)Nc1ccccc1). (Reaction: acyl chloride amidation)

Step2: Perform Heck coupling between 4-bromobenzenesulfonyl chloride (SMILES: ClS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(Br)cc1) and intermediate A to give product B: ClS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc2ccccc2)cc1 (the sulfonyl chloride still present). Reaction: Heck (aryl bromide + alkene).

Step3: Sulfonamide formation between product B (sulfonyl chloride) and p-toluidine (SMILES: Cc1ccc(N)cc1) to give final target.

All precursors are commercially available: aniline, acryloyl chloride, 4-bromobenzenesulfonyl chloride, p-toluidine. Prices likely under $10k.
